youtube_short.title: The $8,700 Monthly Payment Car Trap
title_alternatives: Why 'What's Your Monthly Budget?' Is Costing You Thousands
Car Dealers Don't Want You to Know This
youtube_short.description: The moment a car dealer asks 'what monthly payment works for you?' — the trap is already set. They stretch your loan to 84 months so payments feel manageable, but you end up paying $3,200 more in interest and owing more than the car is worth by month 18. Most people roll that negative equity into their NEXT car loan six to eight times. Here's the one question that stops the whole cycle cold. #carbuying #personalfinance #moneytips #carloan
